q1.sampleAnswer: My name is Li Ming. I’m thirteen years old. I live in Chengdu, in China. I text my friends two or three times every evening, usually about homework. In the evening I spend time with my family. We have dinner together and sometimes watch TV. Last Saturday evening I went to my grandparents’ house. We ate dumplings and played cards, and I went to bed quite late. When the weather is cold, I usually go to the shopping centre or stay at home and read. When the weather is warm, I like riding my bike in the park with my friends.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法与词汇：简单语法结构的掌握，日常话题词汇的运用
互动交流：回答切题，内容充分，能延展回答
整体表现：能用简单的语言完成交流任务

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答能直接回答每个问题，并多说一两句理由或细节（例如晚上和谁在一起、上周六晚上做了什么、天冷天热时去哪里做什么），用简单而正确的句子连贯表达。

q2.sampleAnswer: I like playing music because it’s fun to play with my friends. I don’t like doing maths very much because it’s difficult for me. I think writing stories is interesting, because I can use my imagination. Learning about history isn’t boring – I like learning about people in the past. Playing music isn’t easy, you need to practise a lot. Painting pictures is fun and relaxing. I like playing music best. I think it’s useful to learn about the geography of the world, because we can learn about other countries. Yes, it’s important to play sport at school, because it keeps us healthy and we can make friends.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答会对图片中的每项学校活动（数学、写故事、历史、音乐、画画）表明喜欢与否并给出理由，能回答考官的追问，说出最喜欢哪一项，并用 because 等连接词展开；最后两个问题要说明在学校学地理、做运动是否有用或重要以及原因。
